Wehave the Udu Dasa or length of life measured by the planets according to the constellations ruling at birth. We have secondly Kalachakra Dasas and the longevity given by them. Third, we have the Graha Datta pindayuryog or the term of life given by all the planets to the Foetus at the time of conception. Fourth, we have the Amsayurdaya recommended by Satyacharya and followed by Varahamihira. Fifth, we have the longevity determined by the Gochara movements of the planets. Sixth, the longevity as determined by the Kendra Ayurdaya. Seventh, we have the Dasantur Dasa Ayurdaya. Then, eighthly, we have the Astataverga Bintusodhana Ayurdaya.
